a.lede: Russian bot traffic falls dramatically as Ukraine takes out several Yandex data centers.
a.title: Russia's Yandex bot traffic nearly eliminated overnight after Ukraine drone strikes cripple multiple of 'Russia's Google' data centers

b.lede: Following a Ukrainian drone strike on a D.C. in Sasovo, Russia, a Yandex facility in Kaluga has suffered a similar fate with multiple modules completely out of service.
b.title: Ukrainian drones strike largest data center in Russia, multiple parts of 1.4 million square foot campus knocked offline
